scientific_integrity: The regenerative stationary density is prior literature; the fixed-particle-number multivariate far-tail asymptotic, conditional co-extremes, and moment thresholds are derived and separately self-checked here. No human/independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Fixed integer N>=3, identical one-dimensional diffusion coefficients, common positive absorbing/reset threshold, all-particle instantaneous zero resetting.
Fixed positive excursion threshold ratios as R tends to infinity; no uniformity in growing N.
Independent priority and proof audit not performed.
title: Universal multivariate extreme tails in a first-passage-reset Brownian gas
